thread:
alex.lewis: Heads up — pre-merge SAST on staging-service flagged a high severity finding: "possible command injection" in vendor/template-sql builder. Attaching scanner output and stack snippet. Can someone triage?

maria_gupta: pinging triage. is it reproducible locally or only in CI?

samc: I looked. Scanner points at vendor code that builds SQL from templates. Likely a fuzzy/heuristic hit — vendor uses a harmless fmt-based template in our config. Need a quick repro to be sure.

alex.lewis: Repro steps from CI:
```
SAST_RULE=S2001
scanner run --artifact=staging-service:build-345 --path=services/staging/src/db/template.go
--- output ---
S2001: potential command injection in template.go:142
  at vendor/github.com/x/template/sqlbuilder.go:67
  evidence: fmt.Sprintf("exec %s", cfg.Query)
```

jen-ops: if reproducing requires decrypted test fixtures, the scanner service account currently can't read them. That's why CI only shows the heuristic and we can't run full trace.

maria_gupta: right — to reproduce we need the fixture bucket (s3://redwood-staging-fixtures) which is KMS-encrypted. Do we want to grant the scanner ephemeral access or create a local repro fixture?

samc: local repro would be ideal but will take ~1h. Short-lived KMS grant would be faster for triage. If we do that, please ensure the grant is auditable.

sec-bot: Policy alert: rule S2001 triggered 1 time(s). Owner required: security-team-db. See /policies/sast/S2001 for guidance. :warning:

alex.lewis: Can we do an ephemeral grant scoped only to kms:Decrypt for the scanner SA and log CloudTrail event id to the PR? That should preserve auditability.

jen-ops: Yes — we can create a time-limited IAM role with sts:AssumeRole for the scanner SA and a KMS key policy permit for Decrypt for that role. We'll record the CloudTrail event and link it. I need an APPROVER (security) for the change.

maria_gupta: I can review once you post the IAM change. Also propose we attach an "evidence bundle" to the PR that includes: scanner output, the minimal repro file, and the CloudTrail event id for the KMS decrypt. That will satisfy compliance for suppression decisions.

samc: sounds good. If we confirm it's a false positive we add a scoped suppression with comment and link to evidence bundle (owner signoff required). If it's real, we patch vendor usage or add input sanitization.

alex.lewis: I ran a quick local test after pulling the vendor file — behavior matches CI but I couldn't reproduce command execution. Looks like a false positive. I'm going to request the ephemeral grant to collect the KMS logs and final proof.

jen-ops: Created IAM role: 
```
Role: role/scanner-ephemeral-triage-2026-03-20
AssumeRole: scanner-sa@redwood-infra
Expire: 1 hour
KMS policy: Allow Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```
CloudTrail EventID: c3f9a2b4-9d2e-4a1b-8f1a-0c2d3e4f5a6b (attached to PR #842)

maria_gupta: Received logs and minimal repro from alex. Evidence bundle uploaded to PR #842/files/evidence.zip. I reviewed stack trace and vendor code — definite heuristic hit: fmt.Sprintf used to format SQL for logging only, never executed as shell. Marking as false positive.

samc: Please add suppression with the following text: "S2001 false positive — logging-format only; verified with fixture and KMS audit c3f9a2b4-9d2e-4a1b-8f1a-0c2d3e4f5a6b; owner @maria_gupta"

alex.lewis: Done — added suppression entry in repo at .scans/suppressions.yaml and linked PR. Suppression id: supp-20260320-01.

sec-bot: Suppression recorded. Auto-attach: evidence bundle PR#842. Reminder: suppressions expire in 180 days unless renewed.

jen-ops: RBAC change (ephemeral role) will be removed automatically after 1 hour. I'll follow up with audit export to compliance.

oncall-bot: Note: triage SLA met — first triage in 12 minutes. :tada:

alex.lewis: Thanks all. Closing thread — leaving the suppression and the evidence bundle linked. If anyone wants a deeper vendor patch, we can open a follow-up task to replace logging formatter.

maria_gupta: filing follow-up ticket to track vendor patch (TICKET-1254). cc @samc

samc: ack.
